- prefix="`r prefix`" is used to reference the files generated by the pipeline.
- `COUNT` = `r COUNT` controls whether the read-counting step using `featureCounts` is performed and is set to `FALSE` by default.

# Read `bismark` outputs with `bsseq`



```{r bsseq_read_bismark, eval=COUNT, echo=TRUE, results="verbatim"}
# stop("EFN")
library(bsseq)
library(BiocParallel)
register(SerialParam(), default = TRUE)

bs <- bsseq::read.bismark(
    files = e$covgz,
    colData = e,
    rmZeroCov = FALSE,
    strandCollapse = TRUE,
    BPPARAM = SerialParam(),
    nThread = 1
)

# bs = bsseq::read.bismark(files=e$covgz, colData=e, rmZeroCov=FALSE, strandCollapse=TRUE, nThread=1)
bs = GenomeInfoDb::keepStandardChromosomes(bs, pruning.mode = "coarse")
# saveRDS(bs, "bs_full.rds")
# ```

# ```{r filtering, eval=COUNT}
# bs = readRDS("bs_full.rds")
dim(bs)

cov = bsseq::getCoverage(bs)
# apply_func = epimedtools::monitored_apply
apply_func = apply
cov = apply_func(as.matrix(cov), 1, mean)
l2cov = log2(cov + 1)
tabl2cov_full = table(round(l2cov))

# Coverage filter: >=10x in at least 80% of samples
keep = which(rowSums(bsseq::getCoverage(bs) >= 10) >= 0.8 * ncol(bs))
bs = bs[keep, ]
dim(bs)

# cov = getCoverage(bs)
# grp = pData(bs)$hiloDDE
# keep = rowSums(cov[, grp == "hi"] >= 10) >= 0.8 * sum(grp == "hi") &
#        rowSums(cov[, grp == "lo"] >= 10) >= 0.8 * sum(grp == "lo")
# bs = bs[keep, ]

cov = bsseq::getCoverage(bs)
cov = apply_func(as.matrix(cov), 1, mean)
l2cov = log2(cov + 1)
tabl2cov = table(round(l2cov))

layout(matrix(1:2, 1), respect=TRUE)
barplot(tabl2cov_full)
barplot(tabl2cov)

saveRDS(bs, "bs.rds")
```


```{r bsseq object load}
bs = readRDS("bs.rds")
```


## Fingerprint (CpG coverage)

```{r fingerprint}
cov = bsseq::getCoverage(bs)
data = as.matrix(t(cov))
# Compute cumulative signal fractions for each row
cs = t(apply(data, 1, function(x) cumsum(sort(x)) / sum(x)))

fois = factoi[sapply(factoi, function(fa) {class(e[[fa]])})=="factor"]
for (foi in c("null", fois)) {
  layout(1, respect=TRUE)
  col = as.numeric(e[,foi])
  names(col)=rownames(e)
  matplot(t(cs), type="l", lty=1, col=adjustcolor(col, alpha.f=0.7),
    xlab="Ranked genomic features",
    ylab="Cumulative fraction of signal")
  legend("topleft", col=1:length(levels(e[,foi])), levels(e[,foi]), pch=16, title=foi)
}
```


# PCA on methylation beta vales 



```{r pca}
beta = bsseq::getMeth(bs, type = "raw")
meth = list(
#  mvalues = logit(beta),
  beta = beta
)

for (k in names(meth)) {
  print(k)
  data = as.matrix(t(meth[[k]]))
  data = data[,!apply(is.na(data), 2, any)]
  pca = prcomp(data, scale=FALSE)
  v = pca$sdev * pca$sdev
  p = v / sum(v) * 100

  fois = factoi[sapply(factoi, function(fa) {class(e[[fa]])})=="factor"]
  for (foi in c("null", fois)) {
    layout(matrix(1:6,2), respect=TRUE)
    # layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
    barplot(p, ylab="% of variance explained", xlab="components")
    cols = as.numeric(e[rownames(pca$x),foi])
    legend("topright", col=1:length(levels(e[,foi])), levels(e[,foi]), pch=16, title=foi, bty="n")

    for (i in 1:5) {
      j = i+1
      plot(
        pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j],
        xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
        ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
        col=cols,
        pch=16
      )
    }
    layout(1, respect=TRUE)
    i=1 ; j = i+1
    plot(
      pca$x[,1], pca$x[,j],
      xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
      ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
      col=adjustcolor(1, alpha.f=0.5),
      main=k,
      pch=16
    )
    text(pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j], rownames(pca$x))
  }
}



```



```{r}
# Extract methylation beta values
beta = bsseq::getMeth(bs, type = "raw")
rownames(beta) = paste0(seqnames(bs), ":", start(bs))
dim(beta)
head(beta)
saveRDS(beta, "beta_matrix.rds")
beta = apply(mod=10000, as.matrix(beta), 1, mean)

layout(matrix(1:2, 1), respect=TRUE)

# Plot global beta distribution
hist(as.vector(beta),
     breaks = 100,
     col = "grey70",
     border = NA,
     xlab = "Beta value",
     ylab = "Frequency",
     main = "DNA methylation distribution")

# library(bsseq)
library(GenomicRanges)

# Extract genomic coordinates
gr = sort(granges(bs))
# Compute distances between consecutive CpGs
pos_by_chr = split(start(gr), as.character(seqnames(gr)))
d = unlist(lapply(pos_by_chr, function(pos) {
    diff(pos)
}), use.names = FALSE)

# Plot the distribution
hist(log10(d),
     breaks = 100,
     col = "grey70",
     border = NA,
     xlab = "log10(Distance between consecutive CpGs)",
     main = "CpG spacing distribution")
```
